hypothesis: Benchmark-transfer instability: method ranking/failure patterns may change between controlled benchmarks and realistic AR-native conditions.
evidence_origin: Different benchmark contracts between EuRoC/TUM-style SLAM-VIO evaluation and LaMAR AR localization.
test_design: Use only task-compatible components; compare rank/failure stability across matched controlled and AR-native tracks.

hypothesis: Optimization-based and filter-based VIO may occupy different accuracy/robustness/resource regimes under identical sensor data.
evidence_origin: Mechanistic split between VINS-Mono and OpenVINS.
test_design: Reproduce on identical EuRoC/TUM-VI sequences with common evaluator and hardware.

hypothesis: Modular learned retrieval/matching pipelines expose accuracy-latency-resource trade-offs that are not captured by accuracy-only reporting.
evidence_origin: HLoc/LaMAR modular pipelines and AR deployment constraints.
test_design: Factorial component benchmark on LaMAR validation with fixed maps, queries and thresholds.

hypothesis: Single-session SLAM accuracy may be insufficient evidence for persistent multi-session/shared AR localization.
evidence_origin: LaMAR explicitly models multi-session, heterogeneous-device AR mapping/localization.
test_design: Compare single-session assumptions against cross-session/device validation tracks.
